tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh original drawing based on the sole attached adopted Blue Tree Monitor character identity/style reference, not a pixel edit. Preserve the exact blue/dark-slate skin patches, warm brown outlines, cream muzzle and belly ONLY, plain brown pupils inside white eyes without sparkle highlights, two short arms and two planted feet with the same simple brown toe lines, one curved tail on viewer right. It is the same lightly anthropomorphic upright character, no clothing or props. CRITICAL: both forepaws/hands/fingers are BLUE WITH EXISTING BLUE/DARK PATCHES everywhere, including the inner palm, fingertips and any turned surface. NO white/cream/tan palms, finger pads, claws or new undersurface markings; source hands are blue. Keep original head/neck/shoulder/abdomen and planted-foot proportions, no short torso. Genuine transparent RGBA background; full figure and appendages comfortably inside each cell. Clean original warm contour and intentional soft painted paper texture, no bleeding, mud, red fringe, shadows, ground, text, extra parts or marks. Create ONLY ONE full-body standalone image on the same1254x1254 transparent canvas with the figure in the same position, size and full standing silhouette as the reference. Change ONLY the eyes to two smooth closed-eye curves. Exact reference head top about y196, cream muzzle/chin level646, torso/feet down to1175, main head/body width611. Preserve the original head-to-torso and feet relationship, face geometry and long torso; do not lower head or compress body as sprite sheets often do. Keep both BLUE forepaws relaxed exactly as reference, no cream palm additions. No other pose change.
